LanguageData.LP_MT_UnyieldingSpent.label: indomitable (cooldown)
LanguageData.LP_MT_UnyieldingSpent.description: Just crawled back from death's door; won't be so lucky next time: Indomitable won't save a life again until the cooldown ends.
LanguageData.LP_MT_Momentum.label: press the advantage
LanguageData.LP_MT_Momentum.description: Just finished off an enemy personally, and I'm on a roll: melee and shooting hit +10%.
LanguageData.LP_MT_Sunburn.label: sunburnt
LanguageData.LP_MT_Sunburn.description: Vampire's curse: sunlight stings the skin like needles. Movement -15%, consciousness -10%, 1 burn damage per hour. Fades indoors or after dark.
